name: Simple Church Rota
shortDescription: A UK-developed volunteer rota app for church teams, with scheduling, swaps, calendar sync, team messages, notifications and print-ready rotas.
company: Andrew Bents (developer identity published in Google Play; legal trading entity not established in reviewed public material)
suitableContexts: Small churches replacing volunteer rota spreadsheets
Church teams needing swap and cover requests
Churches wanting calendar-synchronised rotas and notifications without a full church-management suite

pricing.summary: Supplier publishes a 30-day free trial without a card, followed by £35 per year for a church with unlimited rota types and volunteers. Confirm VAT treatment, payment provider, renewal, cancellation and refund terms before purchase.

tiers.label: 30-day trial
tiers.detail: Supplier states that all features are available without a card for 30 days.

tiers.label: Annual subscription
tiers.detail: Supplier states that this includes unlimited volunteers and rota types, calendar tools, notifications, PDF export and email support.

pricing.trialDetails: Supplier advertises a 30-day full-feature trial with no card required.

gdprInformation: The product page describes the service as UK-based and GDPR-aware. Google Play lists developer-provided data-safety information, including personal information, messages and calendar data, encryption in transit and a deletion-request route. The reviewed public material did not establish the legal entity, full privacy notice, controller/processor roles, hosting, sub-processors, retention, export or breach process. Obtain those details in writing before uploading church team or family-directory data.
integrations: iCal-compatible calendars including Apple Calendar and Outlook
importExport: Supplier documents PDF print/export and iCal feeds
Obtain the current people-data export, migration, retention and deletion workflow before purchase
support: Email support is included in the published trial and annual subscription
Google Play lists a public support email
Confirm support hours and data-incident escalation arrangements before adoption

uk-developer-and-availability.value: Google Play lists Andrew Bents as the developer in the United Kingdom, records an update in May 2026 and links the product website and support email.

church-rota-scope.value: Supplier documents church-specific rota types, volunteer scheduling, swaps, cover requests, messages, calendar sync, notification routes and PDF output.

published-pricing.value: Supplier publishes a 30-day no-card trial and £35 annual subscription for unlimited rota types and volunteers.

app-data-safety.value: Google Play's developer-provided data-safety summary records data collection/sharing categories, encryption in transit and a deletion-request route.

editorial.assessment: Simple Church Rota is a focused UK-developed volunteer scheduling product, not a full church database or safeguarding system. It offers a notably low published annual price and a practical set of rota, swap, calendar and notification tools for a small church. The public legal and data-processing material is limited, so it is best assessed with a trial using non-sensitive team details while the church obtains the provider, privacy, hosting and exit information required for wider use.
bestFor: Small churches moving away from rota spreadsheets
Teams needing volunteer availability, swaps, cover requests and reminders
Churches seeking one low-cost rota tool rather than a full suite
strengths: Current UK app-store developer listing and recent recorded update
Church-focused rota, swap, calendar and notification workflow
Published 30-day trial and flat £35 annual price
Google Calendar, iCal, SMS and Telegram routes are described
limitations: The reviewed public material does not establish a legal company or complete contractual identity
It is not a church-management, accounting, Gift Aid or safeguarding case-management platform
Privacy, controller/processor roles, hosting, sub-processors, retention, export and incident arrangements require a written supplier response
SMS, messaging and calendar connections need permission and data-flow checks

procurementVerdict.problem: Replacing volunteer rota spreadsheets, late swap messages and fragmented calendar updates
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A narrowly focused church rota tool with a simple published annual price and multiple notification/calendar options
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Run the 30-day trial with non-sensitive team data, then obtain the provider identity, privacy and export terms before adding family-directory or wider contact records
